# (APPENDIX) Bijlagen {-}

# Overzichtstabel van types in de meetnetten van het grondwatercompartiment {#app:typegroups}

```{r}
targetpop %>% 
    distinct(typeclass_name,
             type,
             type_name,
             type_shortname) %>% 
    arrange(typeclass_name,
             type) %>% 
    kable %>% 
    kable_styling()
```
